title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 340 Wetmore Avenue in Grand River, Ohio, as the Lance Corporal Andy Ace Nowacki Post Office.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 340 Wetmore Avenue in Grand River, Ohio, as the "Lance Corporal Andy 'Ace' Nowacki Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a post office in Grand River, Ohio, after Lance Corporal Andy 'Ace' Nowacki.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 340 Wetmore Avenue in Grand River, Ohio, as the Lance Corporal Andy 'Ace' Nowacki Post Office. It changes only the name of the building. Postal services, hours, and mail delivery stay the same.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020, and the new name applied from that date.
